description: This file defines a sealed class 'DdlScanner' responsible for tokenizing and parsing a domain-specific language (DDL) used within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for scanning identifiers, literals, comments, and punctuation, as well as managing the scanner state and position within the input string.

classes.name: DdlScanner
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for lexically analyzing DDL strings, providing tokenization, lookahead, and position management functionalities.

methods.name: ReadCode
methods.description: Reads the next DDL token, ignoring comments, and updates internal symbol and token state.

methods.name: PeekKeyword
methods.description: Returns the next keyword symbol without advancing the scanner position.

methods.name: PeekPunctuation
methods.description: Returns the next punctuation symbol without advancing the scanner position.

methods.name: PeekSymbol
methods.description: Returns the next symbol (text, keyword, or punctuation) without advancing the scanner position.

methods.name: ReadText
methods.description: Reads text or keywords from the current position, handling line breaks and paragraph continuation.

methods.name: MoveToCode
methods.description: Advances the scanner to the next code token if not already positioned at one.

methods.name: MoveToParagraphContent
methods.description: Moves to the first character of paragraph content, skipping empty lines and comments.

methods.name: MoveToNextParagraphContentLine
methods.description: Moves beyond an EOL to the next paragraph content line, considering root level or nested contexts.

methods.name: ScanIdentifier
methods.description: Scans an identifier token starting at the current position.

methods.name: ScanNumber
methods.description: Scans an integer or real number literal.

methods.name: ScanKeyword
methods.description: Scans a keyword starting with a backslash.

methods.name: ScanPunctuator
methods.description: Scans punctuation symbols such as braces, brackets, operators, etc.

methods.name: ScanVerbatimStringLiteral
methods.description: Scans verbatim string literals enclosed in @"".

methods.name: ScanStringLiteral
methods.description: Scans standard string literals with escape sequences.

methods.name: SaveCurDocumentPos
methods.description: Saves the current position in the document for error reporting.
